entities.summary: Edward Ford Weber was an American lawyer, military veteran and politician from Ohio. He served one term in the United States House of Representatives as a Republican from 1981 to 1983. He also served on the Board of Directors at the Toledo Museum of Art from at least 2011 to 2019.
